profile_text.body:
Ericsson is a public company headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, traded under the ticker ERIC and registered with the SEC under CIK 0000717826. Its website describes it as powering the networks that connect billions, working across 5G, AI, and cloud to serve network providers and enterprises. The company says it helps providers and enterprises unlock what connectivity can do, and it markets secure, reliable enterprise connectivity that unites 5G, AI, and cloud across people, devices, and locations.

Much of the site's material is framed around where networks are heading. Ericsson's CTO writes about four shifts shaping the network into what the company calls a programmable, autonomous, and AI-native intelligent fabric. The site covers 6G as a next step toward an "intelligent fabric" linking people and machines through mobile, cloud, and AI systems, and it discusses building trusted AI for networks on the argument that trust will determine how far AI goes in telecom. Other pages describe advanced 5G capabilities, network slicing, orchestration, and AI-driven tools, and communications and connectivity offerings that combine 5G, AI, and cloud. One page discusses AT&T's Open Radio Access Network (Open RAN) transformation as the foundation for an open, disaggregated, and programmable network.

The record held on the company lists no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers. Its listed aliases are ERICSSON LM TELEPHONE CO and ERICSSON (LM) TEL-SP ADR.
